no_adcom_quote.quote: The division did not refer this efficacy supplement to an advisory committee because the application did not raise significant public health questions on the role of capmatinib in the proposed indication. The application also did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA 213591 (TABRECTA/capmatinib). The Multidiscipline Review (Section 9) and the FDA approval letter both state the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise significant safety, efficacy, or public health questions. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
